_comment: OCScale pricing file (user-editable). Price changes only require editing this file — no rebuild needed; the app re-reads it on every pricing refresh. DeepSeek official rates live under `models` (CNY per 1M tokens, split by Beijing-time peak/off-peak). `peak_windows` are the Beijing peak hours ([start, end), 09:00-12:00 and 14:00-18:00); `offpeak`/`peak` are the off-peak/peak prices. With `weekend_offpeak: true`, weekends are billed at the off-peak rate all day from `weekend_offpeak_from` (Beijing date, inclusive) onward. Cache-write tokens bill at the cache-miss input rate; cache-hit input maps to `input_hit`. `flat_usd` holds per-token USD backstop models (no peak split). CNY is converted to USD at the fixed rate 7.2 used by the UI.
